## Overview

Omnibus dependency catalog and package build recipes.
## Interface

- Each Ruby file registers an Omnibus `name`, dependencies, sources, version metadata and/or a `build` block. Definitions are evaluated by the external Omnibus DSL, not standalone Ruby programs.
- `keycloak-server.rb:name/build` packages Keycloak into embedded/apps/keycloak-server/keycloak; `postgresql.rb:build` runs configure, make world and install-world.
- `ruby.rb:build`, `openssl.rb:build`, `chef.rb:build` and `runit.rb:build` build the embedded runtime, libraries, Chef gems and service supervision tools.
- `version-manifest.rb:build` writes version-manifest.txt; cleanup, permissions and shebang definitions transform the final install tree.

## Invariants

- `keycloak-server.rb:default_version` is 26.8.2; project overrides can select other registered versions. This catalog does not determine which dependencies every product ships.
- `ruby.rb/openssl.rb/ncurses.rb:build` select platform/version-specific patches and compiler options; sources and checksums must correspond to the selected artifact.
- `liblzma.rb/libossp-uuid.rb/pcre.rb/pkg-config-lite.rb:source` only select their HTTP mirror fallback when AEROBASE_HTTP_MIRROR_FALLBACKS equals 1.
- `runit.rb:build` patches the default service directory and runs make check before copying tools.
## Side Effects

- Build blocks download upstream archives or Git repositories and gems, execute compilers/package tools, apply patches and write under install_dir; some steps remove generated or installed artifacts.
- `ruby-cleanup.rb:build` removes caches, documentation and build remnants; `gem-permissions.rb:build` changes file permissions; `shebang-cleanup.rb:build` rewrites scripts/batch files.
- `openssl.rb:build` may invoke sudo slibclean on AIX; `scripts/internal_sources.rb` is a separate upload workflow, not part of a catalog-only check.
## Verification

From the `omnibus-software` repository root after installing the Gemfile dependencies: `bundle exec rake test` loads all software definitions; `bundle exec rake style` checks Ruby style. Full platform builds are separate and execute the build side effects above.
